What degraded

  • The deck ships UNDER the scoring bar. Panel median 7.21 against 8.0, a shortfall of 0.79, at the round 5 cap. No judge found a hard fail and all three said their refusal was on the threshold rather than on a fault.
  • Seven of the nine slides ship as PNG rather than WEBP. The encoder measured each of the seven under its 40.0 dB quality floor even at quality 96, so it shipped the larger correct file. Only slides 04 and 05 cleared the floor.
  • tx-2026-0120 hard fails on staleness on September 23rd, 2026 if the Department of Homeland Security keeps refusing the fetch. Its source has now gone unread for four days running.
  • The caption ledger off by one recurred, for the fourth time.
  • The run froze mid Phase 16 with the shipped artifact directory in a broken state, and the owner found it rather than a gate.

Named here rather than left out. A run that quietly ships less than it planned teaches nobody anything.

Post this

Upload the PDF to LinkedIn as a document, title it A truck takes a picture of your house, paste the post copy under it, then paste the first comment within a minute of posting.

carousel.pdf   contact sheet   the site

1. The post copy

Is a courtesy notice a warning?

Dallas says no. NBC 5 reported the city manager's memo saying "A courtesy notice is not a warning or a violation." The city says it sent courtesy notices to 3,700 property owners. The one an Oak Cliff homeowner opened carried "violations identified" in bold near the top. The notice asks owners to correct the violations to avoid further enforcement action. Pressed, Code Compliance assistant director Jeremy Reed said "you could call that a warning."

No automated ticketing was the December 2025 promise to the Finance Committee. FOX 4 reported the memo saying a code officer inspects in person before a citation issues. That is the city's account of its own process, not an audit.

That memo is posted at no public address this record found. How does a homeowner weigh a letter against a document they can't read?

#DallasCityCouncil #CodeCompliance #CityDetect

Notes

## The run stopped, and nothing gated it Mid Phase 16 this run stopped with the shipped artifact directory carrying **no image at all for slide 02**, and it stayed stopped until the owner said so. An unattended run that halts with a known broken artifact has failed at the one thing it is for. `prompt_audit.py` measured **1571 tool calls this run and none waited on a human.** That is the reading that matters, because it removes the one explanation that would have made this a machine problem. Nothing prompted. The run simply did not continue. ## What broke the artifact directory Two `ship_images.py` processes were launched concurrently, one backgrounded with a shell `&` and a second through the tool's own background flag. `ship_images` removes the source PNG after a successful encode, so the two raced and each destroyed the other's inputs. Repaired by restoring all nine slides and nine thumbs from `out/2026-09-21/render/`, re-shipping in a single foreground run, and then auditing every slide, every thumb and `og.jpg` one by one. ## A commit reached origin carrying Anthropic trailers `7ef5988` held a `Co-Authored-By` line and a session link, both permanently forbidden. The tree was identical to its amended replacement and no pull request was open, so it was force pushed with `--force-with-lease`. Zero commits on this branch carry a forbidden trailer now. ## Seven over length sentences reached the built site `house_style_check` caught them on the run branch before the merge. `main` was clean, so all seven were this run's, in the summaries of the two new items and in re-verification notes on four older ones. Fixed in `ledger/docket.json`, where the sentences are written, and never in `docs/`. ## The destinyhosted robots finding The vendor portal carrying tx-2026-0168's agenda entry publishes an exclusion file that refuses every client, so the record can't go back to it and the county's own minutes archive would not answer either. Recorded in the item's history rather than worked around. ## Why the deck stopped at round 5 Four rounds moved the median 6.94, 6.80, 6.72, 7.05 and 7.21. That is sideways, which is the pattern `max_rounds` exists to stop. Each round also produced a DISJOINT set of elements the storyboard declared and the render does not carry, sixteen across four rounds with no two rounds naming the same one. The cause is that per frame acceptance lists assert measurable properties and nothing in the suite measures them. That is a machine defect and it is logged as backlog entries 13, 14 and 15 rather than spent on a sixth round.

This is a draft. Nothing was sent. The deck is already merged to main, so these links are live. Posting is the only step left, and it is yours.
